mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp in 2 months signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE decreases by > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during monetary tightening cycles, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO > 110 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those cycles.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing RSAFS (above 350000) and decreasing UNRATE (below 4.5%) signals a strong demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS, UNRATE, and demand indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in CPIAUCSL below 200 signals decreased inflationary pressures, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during late-cycle expansions, or 5-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL < 200 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those cycles.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing PAYEMS (above 138000) and decreasing UNRATE (below 4.2%) signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between PAYEMS, UNRATE, and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5% signals strong economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during early-cycle expansions, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those cycles.
